key_points: Halliburton gained relevant work with a Venezuela project collaboration and a multi-year Eni contract offshore Cyprus.
The awards support backlog and geographic diversification, though undisclosed economics limit their financial significance.
Venezuela exposure adds execution, sanctions and political risk that tempers the positive read-through.
Indian HAL delivery and brokerage headlines are an unrelated ticker collision and should be excluded.
No earnings, guidance, M&A or major management news appears thesis-changing; most remaining coverage is noise.
